title: bardolier shell output
description: The exec invocation for a running project's dev container. cli-spec.md §6 (Shell). The CLI names the command; the app spawns the terminal. Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

container.description: The running dev container, e.g. bardolier-myapp.

exec.description: Argv to run verbatim — an array, not a string, so the app needs no quoting and no shell.

workdir.description: Where the shell lands inside the container: the bind-mounted project directory.
